description: Language-aware follow-up questions for the existing clinical triage interview. Clinical rules stay in ClinicalTriageEngine and datasets; this file only stores patient-facing question text. Selection is driven by required_when concept tags — expand tags/rows rather than hardcoding PHP flows.

questions.clinical_purpose: Clarify exact site when only a general body region is known
questions.english: Where exactly is the problem located in that area of your body?
questions.tagalog: Saan exactamente sa bahaging iyon ng katawan ang problema?
questions.hiligaynon: Diin gid nga parte sang sina nga bahin sang imo lawas ang problema?

questions.english: Which eye is affected — left, right, or both?
questions.tagalog: Aling mata ang apektado — kaliwa, kanan, o pareho?
questions.hiligaynon: Diin nga mata ang apektado — tuo, wala, ukon duha?

questions.english: Where do you feel the pain or discomfort?
questions.tagalog: Saan mo nararamdaman ang sakit o hindi komportableng pakiramdam?
questions.hiligaynon: Diin mo nabatyagan ang sakit ukon discomfort?

questions.english: What symptoms are you feeling, and where in your body?
questions.tagalog: Anong mga sintomas ang nararamdaman mo, at saan sa katawan?
questions.hiligaynon: Ano nga mga sintomas ang imo nabatyagan, kag diin sa imo lawas?

questions.english: Are you having difficulty breathing, or is it hard to speak because you are breathless?
questions.tagalog: Nahihirapan ka ba huminga, o mahirap bang magsalita dahil sa hirap ng paghinga?
questions.hiligaynon: Budlay bala ang imo ginhawa, ukon mabudlay bala maghambal tungod sa kakulang sang ginhawa?

questions.english: Do you have weakness or numbness in one arm or leg?
questions.tagalog: May panghihina o pamamanhid ba sa isang braso o binti mo?
questions.hiligaynon: May kaluya ukon pamamanhid bala sa isa ka kamot ukon tiil mo?

questions.english: Are you having difficulty speaking or is your speech slurred?
questions.tagalog: Nahihirapan ka ba magsalita o malabo ba ang iyong pananalita?
questions.hiligaynon: Budlay bala maghambal ukon indi maathag ang imo hambal?

questions.english: Have you had sudden vision changes, such as loss of vision or double vision?
questions.tagalog: May biglaang pagbabago ba sa paningin, tulad ng pagkawala ng paningin o dobleng paningin?
questions.hiligaynon: May gulpi nga pagbag-o bala sa imo panulok, pareho sang pagkadula sang panulok?

questions.clinical_purpose: Screen vision change / eye danger signs
questions.english: Have you noticed any vision loss, blurry vision, or sensitivity to light?
questions.tagalog: May pagbabago ba sa paningin, malabo, o masakit sa liwanag?
questions.hiligaynon: May pagbag-o bala sa imo panulok, malabo, ukon masakit kung makakita ka sang suga/hayag?

questions.english: Is the bleeding still continuing?
questions.tagalog: Patuloy pa rin ba ang pagdurugo?
questions.hiligaynon: Nagapadayon pa bala ang pagdugo?

questions.clinical_purpose: Determine if bleeding is heavy or uncontrolled
questions.english: Is the bleeding heavy or does it continue despite applying pressure?
questions.tagalog: Malakas ba ang pagdurugo at hindi ito tumitigil kahit dinidiinan?
questions.hiligaynon: Madamo bala ang dugo kag indi ini mag-untat bisan ginapugngan?

questions.english: Do you feel dizzy, weak, or like you might faint?
questions.tagalog: Nahihilo ka ba, nanghihina, o para kang mahimatay?
questions.hiligaynon: Nalilipong bala ikaw, nagakaluya, ukon daw magapunaw?

questions.english: Does the chest pain spread to your arm, back, neck, or jaw?
questions.tagalog: Kumakalat ba ang sakit sa dibdib papunta sa braso, likod, leeg, o panga?
questions.hiligaynon: Nagalapta bala ang sakit sang dughan paadto sa kamot, likod, liog, ukon panga?

questions.clinical_purpose: Detect associated sweating or faintness with chest pain
questions.english: Are you sweating a lot, or feeling dizzy or like you might faint?
questions.tagalog: Pinagpapawisan ka ba nang malakas, o nahihilo / para kang mahimatay?
questions.hiligaynon: Naga singot bala gid ikaw, ukon nalilipong / daw magapunaw?

questions.english: Do you have vomiting, fever, or any bleeding with the abdominal pain?
questions.tagalog: May pagsusuka, lagnat, o pagdurugo ba kasama ng sakit sa tiyan?
questions.hiligaynon: May suka, hilanat, ukon pagdugo bala upod sa sakit sang tiyan?

questions.english: Do you have a fever, and if measured, what was the temperature?
questions.tagalog: May lagnat ka ba, at kung sinukat, magkano ang temperatura?
questions.hiligaynon: May hilanat bala ikaw, kag kung ginsukot, pila ang temperatura?

questions.english: Where exactly do you feel the pain in your nose?
questions.tagalog: Saan mo nararamdaman ang sakit sa ilong?
questions.hiligaynon: Diin gid ang sakit sa imo ilong?

questions.english: Where on your skin is the problem, and is it spreading?
questions.tagalog: Saan sa balat ang problema, at kumakalat ba ito?
questions.hiligaynon: Diin sa imo panit ang problema, kag nagalapta bala ini?

questions.english: Is there pain or burning when you urinate, and is there blood or fever?
questions.tagalog: May sakit o hapdi ba kapag umiihi, at may dugo o lagnat?
questions.hiligaynon: May sakit ukon hapdi bala kung mag-ihi, kag may dugo ukon hilanat?

questions.clinical_purpose: Collect numeric pain score as supporting information
questions.english: On a scale of 1–10, where 1 is the least painful and 10 is the most painful, how severe is your pain?
questions.tagalog: Sa scale na 1 hanggang 10, kung saan ang 1 ay pinakamahinang sakit at ang 10 ay pinakamalalang sakit, gaano kasakit ang nararamdaman mo?
questions.hiligaynon: Sa scale nga 1 tubtob 10, diin ang 1 amo ang pinakagamay nga kasakit kag ang 10 amo ang pinakagrabe, ano ka grabe ang imo sakit?

questions.english: When you say dizzy, does the room spin, do you feel lightheaded, or unsteady?
questions.tagalog: Kapag sinasabi mong nahihilo, umiikot ba ang paligid, gaan ang ulo, o hindi ka matatag?
questions.hiligaynon: Ang imo hilo, daw naga-tuyok bala ang palibot, gaan ang ulo, ukon indi ka stabile magtindog?

questions.clinical_purpose: Determine sudden versus gradual onset / timing
questions.english: When did this start, and did it begin suddenly or gradually?
questions.tagalog: Kailan ito nagsimula, at biglaan ba o unti-unti?
questions.hiligaynon: San-o ini nagsugod, kag gulpi bala ukon hinay-hinay?

questions.clinical_purpose: Determine how long symptoms have lasted
questions.english: How long have you had these symptoms?
questions.tagalog: Gaano na katagal ang mga sintomas na ito?
questions.hiligaynon: Makadugay na bala ini nga mga sintomas?

questions.english: Is your cough dry, or do you bring up phlegm?
questions.tagalog: Tuyong ubo ba, o may plema?
questions.hiligaynon: Uga bala ang imo ubo, ukon may plema?

questions.clinical_purpose: Identify other associated symptoms without assuming negatives
questions.english: Do you have any other symptoms besides what you already described?
questions.tagalog: May iba pa ba kayong sintomas maliban sa naisabi na?
questions.hiligaynon: May iban pa bala nga sintomas luwas sa imo nagsiling?
